name: Superior Sheet Metal
old_description: Superior Sheet Metal services the New England area (MA, NH, VT, RI, CT) as a well respected manufacturer of high quality rectangular and spiral duct fittings/air ducts for the heating, ventilating, and air conditioning (HVAC) industry.
about:
Superior Sheet Metal operates from Hudson, New Hampshire, as a veteran-owned fabrication shop serving the New England region. The company produces spiral and rectangular ductwork and fittings for the heating, ventilation, and air conditioning industry, covering Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Vermont, Rhode Island, and Connecticut.

The 25,000-square-foot facility fabricates single- and double-wall duct and fittings from materials including G90 galvanized steel, Galvaneal, stainless steel, aluminum, cold-rolled steel, and PCD-coated steel. The shop handles specialty items and provides free quotes and estimating assistance, with material lifting baskets available for jobsite delivery.

Primary customers are HVAC and mechanical contractors who rely on quick turnaround and on-time delivery throughout New England. The company programs clients into a Nextel system for immediate communication, useful for last-minute changes on projects.

Leadership comes from personnel with hands-on trade experience as installers, shop workers, foremen, and managers, which the company says informs its understanding of contractor needs and product quality.

SupplyOne Plastics, Inc. was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Reading, Pennsylvania. The company operates as both a packaging manufacturer and a national distributor, providing local service across the United States.

The company manufactures corrugated packaging and offers digital printing, food packaging development, packaging automation, kitting and fulfillment, and vendor-managed inventory programs. It also provides structural and graphic design, packaging use assessments, inventory management, price protection, vendor consolidation, equipment service programs, e-commerce solutions, electronic summary billing, energy reduction services, just-in-time delivery, project management, on-site services, custom barcoding, packaging fulfillment, and custom online catalogs.

SupplyOne serves food and beverage processors — including meat, poultry, and fish packers — as well as industrial manufacturers, middle-market and family-owned businesses, e-commerce operations, and retail brands. Its food packaging specialists work with fresh, frozen, processed, and ready-to-eat products.

The company differentiates itself with a written guaranteed-savings promise, a focus on reducing total cost of ownership, Certified Packaging Professionals who conduct comprehensive assessments, and a nationwide network that delivers unparalleled local service.

name: Susa USA

We specialize in full plant design to include all engineering, equipment placement, full CAD design and drawings. about:
SUSA USA is headquartered in Orlando, Florida, and was founded in 2016 as a family‑owned‑and‑operated firm drawing on five generations of experience in the food processing equipment sector. The company was established to provide turnkey plant solutions ranging from initial concept through final construction.

The business delivers full plant design services including engineering, equipment placement, and complete CAD design and drawings. Its specialists custom‑build food processing and packaging equipment to client specifications and also offer off‑the‑shelf equipment and parts. SUSA USA supervises plant construction to ensure all units are connected correctly and the facility operates efficiently. The scope covers consulting, planning, manufacturing, and parts supply for projects of various sizes.

Primary customers operate in the food processing and packaging industries, with a stated specialization in dairy and fluid processing plants. The company serves clients needing new facilities, expansions, or equipment upgrades within those sectors.

SUSA USA emphasizes that all equipment is built brand new from high‑quality raw materials, each piece is tested for strength and durability, and the firm stands behind every sale with a satisfaction guarantee. Competitive pricing and decades of planning experience are cited as key differentiators.

name: Swanson Sheet Metal Inc
old_description: Need metal punching, cutting or forming services? You’ve come to the right place. The can-do team at Swanson Sheet Metal takes pride in delivering high quality results quickly, effectively and efficiently. Whether you’re located in our neighborhood in North Carolina or across the country, our wide variety of state-of-the-art equipment combined with our expertise means we can tackle orders for both simple and complex parts, within close tolerances and with accurate completion and delivery times.
about:
Swanson Sheet Metal operates from a 32,000-square-foot facility in Monroe, North Carolina. The company was founded by Wesley Swanson and built a reputation over four decades for custom sheet metal fabrication. In 2007, Keith Williford acquired the business, and in 2021 it was purchased by John Jauch, who remains the hands-on owner directing daily operations.

The shop provides a full range of metal fabrication services including punching, cutting, forming, CNC machining (milling, turning, and routing), laser cutting, spot and robotic welding, roll forming, CNC bending, and thermoforming with custom mold making. Additional capabilities cover prototyping, kitting and assembly, anodizing, etching, powder coating, and electrostatic finishing. The facility houses equipment such as Accurl laser cutters, HAAS CNC mills, a Capital Robotics Fusion Arc 200L robotic welding cell, and Safar Darley press brakes.

Swanson serves industrial and commercial original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) across the United States. Its customer base includes companies requiring precision sheet metal parts, welded assemblies, and finished enclosures for industrial machinery, commercial equipment, and other engineered products.

The company emphasizes direct communication and collaboration with clients, citing its ISO 9001 and UL certifications, certified welders and machinists, and a workflow designed for seamless material handling through shipping as foundations for consistent quality and on-time delivery.

Sweet Spirit Foods was founded in July 2002 in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, by the late Dr. Jayel Jacobs Jr., pastor and CEO of Christian Life Missionary Baptist Church, and his wife, Administrative Director Mrs. Joyce M. Jacobs. The venture began as a Snowie snow‑cone stand at 4621 NE 23rd Street and expanded to mobile food trucks, a restaurant in Langston, multiple Snowie buildings, a convenience store and a car wash in Coyle, all staffed by church volunteers.

The company produces a line of gourmet foods centered on barbecue sauces (mild, medium, hot) and a variety of preserves, jams, jellies, salsas, pickled vegetables and marinated items. Recipes were developed by blending family secrets from church members, and production is coordinated with a co‑packing facility and the agricultural department at Oklahoma State University. The operation remains volunteer‑run, with no disclosed facility size or headcount.

Sweet Spirit Foods sells through mass retailers including Walmart, Sam’s Club, Westlake Ace Hardware and Mardels, as well as at craft fairs, home‑and‑garden shows, conventions, the Oklahoma City and Tulsa State Fairs, and via door‑to‑door sales. A curbside‑pickup and local‑delivery service called Sweet Drop serves the Oklahoma City metro area.

name: Switchgear Solutions Ltd. (SSL)
old_description: SSL specializes in the design, application, sales, and support of electrical equipment for the industrial, commercial, & renewable markets.  We have the knowledge, relationships, and resources to drive power distribution and motor control projects from inception to completion.  Each engineered solution we provide to our customers is tailored to fulfill a specific need, built on a foundation of trust and collaboration, and solidly grounded by our extensive practical experience.
about:
Switchgear Solutions Ltd. (SSL) was established in 2004 in Lancaster, Pennsylvania, as a small manufacturers' representative for switchgear and transformers. The company later added the Substation Solutions Ltd. business name as it expanded its scope.

SSL provides design, application, sales, and support of electrical equipment for industrial, commercial, and renewable markets. Its services include engineering and testing, retrofit applications, power system studies, high‑voltage substation design, and design/build project execution. By 2015 the firm had grown to 18 employees across three offices in the Mid‑Atlantic region; it subsequently refocused on engineered solutions and design/build work rather than traditional bid‑and‑spec projects.

The company serves industrial, commercial, and renewable‑energy customers, delivering projects ranging from 500 kV substations to 460 V custom variable‑frequency‑drive solutions. SSL acts as a single point of contact from initial concept through final commissioning.

SSL emphasizes hands‑on involvement, quick and cost‑effective execution, and attention to detail as its key differentiators, aiming to provide cost‑benefit value on every project.

name: Synergy Renewable Systems, LLC
old_description: Synergy Solar is a family-owned and operated company, based in Stoughton, Wisconsin.  Since 2011, Synergy has been offering solar energy solutions as a cost-savings option for owners, in addition to the environmental benefits of using renewable energy instead of fossil fuels.
about:
Synergy Renewable Systems, LLC, operating as Synergy Solar, is a family-owned and operated company based in Stoughton, Wisconsin. Founded in 2011, the business began offering solar energy solutions as a cost-savings option for property owners, emphasizing the environmental benefits of renewable energy over fossil fuels.

The company installs grid-interactive solar photovoltaic systems for homes and businesses, along with battery backup systems that provide power during outages and enable load-shifting or demand-charge reduction. It also integrates Level 1 and 2 electric-vehicle chargers with solar inverters, allowing customers to monitor vehicle charging from a phone or tablet. Every installation is led by a NABCEP Certified PV Installation Professional, Ryan Harkins (Cert# 051112-80), and the firm handles all permitting and paperwork.

Synergy serves residential homeowners, non-profit organizations, commercial businesses, and schools throughout its service area. The company positions itself as a local alternative to out-of-state sales operations, emphasizing a low-pressure approach and same-as-cash or long-term solar loan financing.

The firm states that it uses only high-quality equipment from reputable manufacturers and that a proper installation of reliable components is the key to a strong return on investment. It highlights an easy process, quality workmanship, and local presence as the factors that set it apart.

name: TCI Packaging
old_description: Founded in 2010, TCI Packaging operates 550,000 square feet of warehouse space at the Port of New Orleans dedicated to the pneumatic bulk transfer and packaging of PVC resins and Polyolefins for international distribution. We offer heavy container drayage and combine our packaging services with our trucking services to create a one stop shop for packaging, storage, and transportation.
about:
Founded in 2010 in New Orleans, Louisiana, TCI Packaging operates a 550,000-square-foot warehouse at the Port of New Orleans. The facility is dedicated to the pneumatic bulk transfer and packaging of PVC resins and polyolefins for international distribution.

The company provides packaging services that transfer bulk PVC resin and polyethylene pellets into 25-kilogram form-fill-seal bags and bulk bags (Super Sacks) on packaging lines, running 24 hours a day, seven days a week. It also offers heavy container drayage, trucking, yard logistics, accounting, and inventory management, combining packaging, storage, and transportation into a single logistics solution.

TCI Packaging serves plastics manufacturers and traders who export resin products worldwide. Its customer base includes producers of PVC and polyethylene resins that require tailored export packaging and logistics support from the Gulf Coast.

The company emphasizes a customer-driven philosophy, tailoring logistics to each client’s needs. Its management team brings a combined 50-plus years of export logistics experience, and the firm operates under a Dream, People, Culture framework that sets quantifiable long-term goals, invests in talent, and maintains a proactive, performance-driven culture.

name: THACO INDUSTRIES USA LLC
old_description: THACO INDUSTRIES specializes in the design, testing, validation, development, manufacturing, and supply of automotive components, assembly, and spare parts for domestic and international automotive manufacturers and assemblers. Its products comply with the stringent technical standards of global automotive brands and are exported to markets such as the United States, Canada, Australia, Russia, South Korea, and Japan.
about:
THACO INDUSTRIES USA LLC is headquartered in Gardena, California, and operates as the U.S. subsidiary of THACO INDUSTRIES, a sub-holding of the Vietnamese conglomerate THACO. The parent corporation traces its roots to Vietnam’s mechanical engineering sector, though a specific founding year for the U.S. entity is not publicly disclosed. The company was established to extend THACO’s integrated manufacturing footprint into North American markets, leveraging a centralized production model based in Chu Lai–Da Nang City and Binh Co–Ho Chi Minh City.

The company designs, tests, validates, and manufactures automotive components, assemblies, and spare parts for domestic and international vehicle makers. Its capabilities span stamping, plastic injection molding (including a 3,200‑ton press), precision CNC machining, welding and structural fabrication, surface treatment, painting, and final assembly.

THACO serves automotive OEMs and Tier‑1 suppliers globally, with exports to the United States, Canada, Australia, Russia, South Korea, and Japan. It also produces semi‑trailers (skeletal, flatbed, dump, cargo) for North American and Australian markets, commercial and household goods (treadmills, pallets, shopping carts, plastic tanks) shipped to the U.S., Canada, Japan, and Australia, and high‑tech products including industrial robots, AGVs, AMRs, and drones. A notable reference is Ford Motor Company’s Q1 certification awarded to its plastic component division.

The company emphasizes an integrated value‑chain approach—in‑house development, strategic partnerships, and joint ventures—to deliver high‑technology products that meet global standards at competitive pricing. It highlights compliance with ISO 9001:2015, IATF 16949:2016, and ISO 14001:2015 as a foundation for its strategic partnerships with large corporations.
